text:
Nina (People Ops): Heads-up: new hire Mira (Platform Eng, L4) starts next Wed 10am PT. I drafted a "manager quickpass" and a minimal who-to-ask map. Putting it here so Evan has one place to check.
Evan (Hiring Manager): Thanks Nina. Plan: 20m intro + 30m systems overview. Can we confirm device, repo access, and sandbox creds ahead of time?
Priya (IT): Device order submitted. Evan, pick Mac or Linux and whether they need a dock. Also tell me which Slack channels to auto-join.
Evan (Hiring Manager): MacBook Air 13, no dock. Auto-join #platform, #deploy, #platform-ops. Cloud roles: platform-read, ci-trigger.
Nina (People Ops): Manager quickpass (copyable):
- Before Day 1: confirm device + Okta, send calendar invites, upload signed offer to people-ops-private.
- Day 1: 10am intro, badge + SSO, buddy meet, team lunch.
- Day 2-3: dev env + repo access, first small task assigned.
- Week1: daily 1:1 (short), runbook tour, shadow deploy run.
- 30/60/90 guidance: 30: map systems & complete task; 60: own a component; 90: propose a measurable improvement.
Liam (Buddy): I'll be Mira's buddy. Planning a 1pm walkthrough Day1 and a short "who-to-ask" doc.
Iris (Security): We'll schedule a 15m security orientation Mon afternoon and send a 2-page pre-read on credentials and secrets.
Priya (IT): Sandbox svc account provisioned with TTL tokens; will DM access flow. Laptop imaged and labeled.
Evan (Hiring Manager): Adding feedback checkpoints: day3 quick sync, week2 formal check, week4 review, then monthly. Also assigning a low-risk infra ticket to land by day3.
Nina (People Ops): Added feedback cadence to the quickpass. OnboardBot: checklist created https://onboard.example/2198765432 :tada:
Evan (Hiring Manager): Looks good. Anything else missing?
Liam (Buddy): Maybe add a note to check calendar visibility and timezone settings. Small but causes first-week confusion.
Nina (People Ops): Good call, added. See you all on Wed to welcome Mira :smile:
